output.summary: The claim was denied because bariatric surgery is excluded under the policy. To proceed, additional documentation is needed and the next steps are outlined below.

items.text: Provide a documented BMI measurement showing eligibility for bariatric surgery.
Provide proof of participation in a supervised weight‑loss program.
Submit the requested evidence to the claims department for review.
If the evidence is accepted, request a reconsideration of the denial under any updated bariatric policy provisions.

Precedent F-BARIATRIC does not apply because the current policy clause C-2024-BARIATRIC explicitly excludes bariatric surgery, and the later learning clause C-2025-BARIATRIC cannot override the governing clause.
Precedent F-GENETIC is irrelevant; it concerns genetic testing, a different service category, and does not address bariatric surgery exclusions.
The denial includes the gate EXCLUSION_NO_BASIS, meaning there is currently no appeal basis and escalation must follow the internal “no basis” process.
